title: TabFM: A Zero-Shot Foundation Model for Tabular Data
abstract: arXiv:2609.37959v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tabular machine learning typically relies on per-dataset workflows, fitting tree ensembles or running AutoML searches from scratch for every task. We present TabFM, a 400M-parameter tabular foundation model that formulates supervised tabular prediction as in-context learning. TabFM produces calibrated zero-shot predictions in a single forward pass without task-specific tuning. Trained entirely on synthetic tables generated from structural causal models, TabFM learns general tabular representations that transfer zero-shot to real-world tasks. Across all 51 benchmark datasets in TabArena (38 classification and 13 regression), zero-shot TabFM ranks first among default tabular foundation models and outperforms tuned AutoML pipelines. translated_title: TabFM：面向表格数据的零样本基础模型
translated_abstract: 表格机器学习通常依赖于针对每个数据集的独立工作流程，即为每个任务从头开始拟合树集成模型或运行AutoML搜索。我们提出了TabFM，一个拥有4亿参数的表格基础模型，它将监督式表格预测问题构建为上下文学习（in-context learning）。TabFM在单次前向传播中即可产生经过校准的零样本预测，无需任何任务特定的调优。TabFM完全在由结构因果模型生成的合成表格上训练，学习到了可零样本迁移至真实世界任务的通用表格表示。在TabArena基准测试的全部51个数据集（38个分类任务和13个回归任务）上，零样本的TabFM在默认配置的表格基础模型中排名第一，并优于经过调优的AutoML流水线。在相同冻结权重的基础上，两个扩展进一步提升了两个赛道上的性能：带有集成和事后校准的多视图特征扩展（TabFM+），以及由大语言模型（LLM）引导的、针对特定数据集的数据预（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: TabFM是一个4亿参数的表格基础模型，将监督式表格预测转化为上下文学习并完全基于合成数据训练，在TabArena全部51个基准数据集上以零样本方式超越经过调优的AutoML流水线排名第一。
en_tdlr: TabFM is a 400M-parameter tabular foundation model that formulates supervised tabular prediction as in-context learning, trained entirely on synthetic data, and ranks first zero-shot across all 51 TabArena benchmark datasets, outperforming tuned AutoML pipelines.
